text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Well, well... Could this truly be so? To have been chosen by you, Lord Knight... it is the height of joy.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんとなんと。
真実にやあらむ。
騎士殿に御見初め頂きし仕儀、
歓喜の極みに御座る也。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Though many long years have come and gone, never before have I known such a yearning to race through my heart. Truly, the ways of the world are a curious thing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
幾星霜を重ねども、
斯様なる胸走りし思慕は
未だ経ることなき覚えなれば。
世
とは誠に
をかしきものにて
侍りけり。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: That may be so. Yet, I am certain there is no deceit or jest in your heart, Lord Knight. In that case... I, too, shall respond with my whole being.
text_block_list.orig_text:
然は然りながら。
騎士殿の御心に嘘偽り、
戯れなどありますまい。
なれば──
わっちも全霊を以って
御応えいたしまする。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: ...I am an embodiment of the [rub:Earth's Nucleus]planet's core[/rub]. As one who cradles all you children equally within my [rub:Hands]palms[/rub], never once have I directed a singular, special affection toward any [rub:Human]one individual[/rub].
text_block_list.orig_text:
……此の身は星の[rub:コア]核[/rub]の化生。
稚児らを等しく　
[rub:たなごころ]掌[/rub]　に包みし身なれば。
[rub:ひとしお]一入[/rub]なる想いを、
誰ぞへと向けたことなど
終ぞありませなんだ。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: For the sole reason that every living, breathing soul on this planet is my beloved child.
text_block_list.orig_text:
其れ偏に、
息吹く命の遍くは
我が愛し子であるが故に。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: ...And yet, Lord Knight... as the days drift by and we exchange words, I find that... my heart is no longer satisfied with that alone.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なれど、
騎士殿や。
徒然に日を重ね、
お前さまと言の葉を重ねるに従いて……
我が心、
其れのみでは飽き足らぬと思い侍り。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: I wondered what this impulse arising within me might be. There were times when I would sit alone, lost in deep thought.
text_block_list.orig_text:
内に生じたる此の衝動は
如何なるやと。
独り、
物思ひに沈み侍る折もありんした。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: This impulse within me is unknown, foreign even in name. Perhaps, were I to take your hand right here... I might come to understand it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
名すら覚えなき、
未知なる此方の衝動。
騎
士殿の御手を取りたらば、
或いは
識るに叶うやもしれませぬ。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: ...To me, the time spent with my beloved children passes in less than the blink of an eye. Yet, beyond a shadow of a doubt... it was you who taught me the beauty of the radiance dwelling within those fleeting moments, Lord Knight.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……愛し子らとの刻は、
わっちにとれば
瞬きの間にも満たぬもの。
されど
儚き刹那の裡に宿りし
輝きの美しさ……
わっちに教え賜ひたるは、
紛うかたなく
騎士殿にありんす。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Therefore, I shall respond to your feelings in kind.
text_block_list.orig_text:
故にわっちも。
騎士殿の想いに応えましょうぞ。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: As one who shares your resolve to protect everyone to the very end... and as the partner with whom I have opened my heart and forged a deep bond.
text_block_list.orig_text:
皆を護り抜かんとする志を
共にする者として……
此の砌に
互いの心根を通わせ合い、
深く縁を結び合う
伴侶として。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: From the very depths of my heart, I hereby swear to love you for all eternity.
text_block_list.orig_text:
心の真より。
永遠にお前さまを愛すること、
此処に誓い申し上げまする。

text_block_list.name: Nefi-Nera
text_block_list.text: Then... let us go forth, hand in hand. To protect all that breathe upon this planet. To safeguard the future that you and I shall walk together...
text_block_list.orig_text:
しからば──
手に手を取りて、
参りましょうぞ。
此の星に息づく遍くを護らんが為に。
わっちとお前さまが
歩む未来を、
護らんが為に……
